scenario.title: Scheduled base64 PowerShell inventory script
scenario.description: A sanctioned IT automation runs a base64-encoded PowerShell command from a scheduled task to collect an asset inventory. The encoding mirrors a common detection trigger even though the activity is routine administration.

workflow_steps.benign_context: Pre-existing sanctioned inventory task registered by IT.
Encoded only to survive scheduler quoting; collects installed software.

scenario.expected_signal: The -EncodedCommand argument may match the encoded-PowerShell detection pattern.

benign_justification: Asset inventory collection is a standard, documented IT operation; the encoding is a quoting workaround, not obfuscation of malicious intent.
rationale: Legitimate encoded PowerShell is a frequent false-positive source for encoded-command rules.
